facts.fact: Voice of Nigeria reports the NDPC chief reminding government data protection officers that non-compliance with the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 carries consequences; the report gives no event date beyond its published date 2026-09-30.

Voice of Nigeria names Dr Vincent Olatunji as National Commissioner and CEO of the Nigeria Data Protection Commission, opening an NDPC programme in Abuja (published date 2026-09-30, no event date given).
